notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: MLA, not MHA: per token each layer caches the compressed latent (kv_lora_rank 512) plus the decoupled rope key (qk_rope_head_dim 64) = 576 elements, one shared K/V stream instead of 2 x v_head_dim; 576 x 61 layers x 2 bytes (bf16) = 70,272 B/token. config.json: hidden_size 7168, 128 heads, num_key_value_heads 128 (irrelevant under MLA), kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64, qk_nope_head_dim 128, v_head_dim 128, num_hidden_layers 61 (60 main + 1 MTP layer from num_nextn_predict_layers 1, so the 60-layer main stack alone is 69,120 B/token), max_position_embeddings 163,840 reached by yarn rope_scaling factor 40 from original_max_position_embeddings 4096, rope_theta 10000.
